content: date-fns v4 + @date-fns/tz is the practical 2026 default for TypeScript projects needing timezone-aware date handling (tree-shakeable, uses Intl/IANA via the runtime, first-class TZ support added in v4); Luxon is a solid chainable-API alternative with mature timezone support; native Temporal is shipping in modern browsers/Node 22+ but not yet universal enough to depend on directly in 2026 -- fine as a future migration target, not a v1 dependency.
